title: Chest Item：Creative ideas
description: Chest Curio Item's additional mod adds imaginative ideas from friends
body:
## The necessary dependency is this：[Chest Curio Item](https://modrinth.com/mod/chest-curio-items)

This mod has added some items, all of which depend on the Chest interface of<Chest Curio Item>

  ![items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7196c2e11d6da19cf2267e1e682cab48bb03f6dd.png)

The above images are mod items, each with strong or weak functions, such as the Tree of Life that increases survival ability

![book](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ad7e9309038848e7f0e686744fbc7fd8f08e60b5.png)

The above image is an additional book display for the mod

This mod is language compatible with en_us and zh_cn
